blocks.en: Swap in the real paths, skills, and done checks. Informal wording works.
blocks.zh: 替换成实际路径、skill 和完成检查。非正式表达也有效。

blocks.en:
- `/poteto-mode read <thread>. restate the underlying issue in your own words, in plain english.`
- `/in-your-own-words <long or messy ask>`
- `/sharpen <the prompt you're about to send>`
- `/poteto-mode investigate why <symptom>. give me what we know, what data you used, and your best hypotheses. don't change any code yet.`
- `use /how to understand <subsystem>. then use /why to find out why it broke recently.`
- `/recall my work on <topic> from last week, then read <issue>.`
- `/teach me why you implemented it this way and not <other way>. what did you trade off?`
- `/poteto-mode take over this branch. read the decision log, find what's done, and continue. don't redo finished work.`
blocks.zh:
- `/poteto-mode read <thread>. restate the underlying issue in your own words, in plain english.` 阅读讨论，用自己的话通俗复述根本问题。
- `/in-your-own-words <long or messy ask>` 复述冗长或混乱请求中的目标和问题。
- `/sharpen <the prompt you're about to send>` 深化待发送的提示词。
- `/poteto-mode investigate why <symptom>. give me what we know, what data you used, and your best hypotheses. don't change any code yet.` 调查症状，说明已知事实、使用的数据及最可信假设，暂不改代码。
- `use /how to understand <subsystem>. then use /why to find out why it broke recently.` 先了解子系统如何运行，再调查近期为何出错。
- `/recall my work on <topic> from last week, then read <issue>.` 回顾上周主题相关工作，再阅读问题。
- `/teach me why you implemented it this way and not <other way>. what did you trade off?` 讲清为何这样实现、与其他方案作了什么取舍。
- `/poteto-mode take over this branch. read the decision log, find what's done, and continue. don't redo finished work.` 接手分支，阅读决策记录，继续未完成部分，不重复已完成工作。

blocks.en:
- Bug: `/poteto-mode <symptom>. repro first, then fix and verify.`
- Bug in an app: `/poteto-mode repro this with /verify-<app>. if it repros on main, fix it and show me a video as proof.`
- Bug with a cheap test: `/poteto-mode repro <bug> first. if there's a cheap test path, /tdd it. then fix and rerun.`
- Feature: `/poteto-mode add <behavior>. <current output> stays byte-identical. verify both.`
- Refactor: `/poteto-mode move <code> into one module, zero behavior change. record the current output first and prove it's unchanged after.`
- Perf: `/poteto-mode <operation> takes <time> on <fixture>. trace it, fix the measured cause, show me before and after.`
blocks.zh:
- Bug：`/poteto-mode <symptom>。先复现，再修复并验证。`
- 应用中的 bug：`/poteto-mode 用 /verify-<app> 复现这个问题。如果在 main 上能复现，就修复并提供视频作为证据。`
- 有低成本测试路径的 bug：`/poteto-mode 先复现 <bug>。如果有低成本测试路径，用 /tdd，再修复并重跑。`
- 功能：`/poteto-mode 添加 <behavior>。<current output> 必须逐字节不变。验证两者。`
- 重构：`/poteto-mode 将 <code> 移入一个模块，行为完全不变。先记录当前输出，再证明改动后没有变化。`
- 性能：`/poteto-mode <operation> 在 <fixture> 上耗时 <time>。采集 trace，修复测量确认的根因，展示前后对比。`

blocks.en:
- `/poteto-mode prototype a few options for <feature>. take screenshots or videos for me to compare.`
- `/poteto-mode we need <feature>. /architect it first, and answer open questions with prototypes. let me review before proceeding.`
- `/poteto-mode write a tutorial for how i would use <new package> first. then /teach me why it beats the current one.`
- `ask /arena for a second opinion on this thread and our approach.`
- `/poteto-mode turn this design into a plan. small verifiable PRs, each with its own verification steps.`
- `/poteto-mode plan the migration of <library> to <target>. small verifiable PRs. the result must match the original exactly, bugs included.`
blocks.zh:
- `/poteto-mode 为 <feature> 做几个方案的原型。提供截图或视频供我比较。`
- `/poteto-mode 我们需要 <feature>。先用 /architect 设计，并通过原型回答未决问题。继续之前先让我审查。`
- `/poteto-mode 先写一份教程，说明我如何使用 <new package>。再用 /teach 解释它为什么优于当前方案。`
- `请 /arena 对这个讨论串和我们的方法提供第二意见。`
- `/poteto-mode 将这个设计转为计划。拆成小而可验证的 PR，每个都有自己的验证步骤。`
- `/poteto-mode 规划将 <library> 迁移到 <target>。拆成小而可验证的 PR。结果必须与原来完全一致，包括 bug。`

blocks.en:
- `/interrogate the whole branch, but skeptically. don't change anything yet. no nitpicks unless it's a real bug or regression.` Read the Dropped list too.
- `/create-formal-verification-skill prove <property> holds in <module>, even when <steps> interleave or retry.` After merges or refactors in that code: `/maintain-formal-verification-skill`.
- `/swarm check every package under <dir> against its check script. one worker per package. one report.`
- `/poteto-mode open the pr. small ordered commits, evidence in the description.`
- `/poteto-mode babysit this pr. get it green.` For status only: `/poteto-mode check on pr <number>. anything outstanding?`
- `/poteto-mode land the stack.`
blocks.zh:
- `/interrogate the whole branch, but skeptically. don't change anything yet. no nitpicks unless it's a real bug or regression.` Read the Dropped list too. 审慎审查整个分支，暂不修改，只保留真实缺陷或回归，并阅读 Dropped 列表。
- `/create-formal-verification-skill prove <property> holds in <module>, even when <steps> interleave or retry.` After merges or refactors in that code: `/maintain-formal-verification-skill`. 验证模块性质在交错和重试下仍成立；合并或重构后运行维护技能。
- `/swarm check every package under <dir> against its check script. one worker per package. one report.` 每个包一位工作者，运行检查并汇总一份报告。
- `/poteto-mode open the pr. small ordered commits, evidence in the description.` 打开 PR，提交小而有序，描述附证据。
- `/poteto-mode babysit this pr. get it green.` For status only: `/poteto-mode check on pr <number>. anything outstanding?` 跟进 PR 到检查通过；只查状态时询问是否还有未完成事项。
- `/poteto-mode land the stack.` 合入已验证的堆栈。

blocks.en:
- `/poteto-mode im going to bed. <goal> in a fresh worktree off <base>. done means <checks>. keep a decision log. don't ask me before committing. /loop until done. if you're truly stuck after a few hours, stop and write up why.`
- `/show-me-your-work catch me up on what you did last night.` Read its Attention section first.
- `/ketchup` catches you up on this chat since your last message and lists every call that waits on you.
- `/poteto-mode full autopilot on this queue. each item is independent.`
- `/poteto-mode autopilot these changes, but don't merge. i'll land them.`
- `/reflect capture what we learned so the next run doesn't repeat it.` Approve only edits that change a future decision.
- `/bro` restates the last reply in plain words.
blocks.zh:
- `/poteto-mode im going to bed. <goal> in a fresh worktree off <base>. done means <checks>. keep a decision log. don't ask me before committing. /loop until done. if you're truly stuck after a few hours, stop and write up why.` 在新 worktree 持续推进目标到检查通过，记录决策，允许直接提交；长时间真正受阻时说明原因。
- `/show-me-your-work catch me up on what you did last night.` Read its Attention section first. 回顾昨晚工作，先阅读 Attention 部分。
- `/ketchup` catches you up on this chat since your last message and lists every call that waits on you. 回顾本聊天自上次消息以来的变化，列出所有待用户决定的事。
- `/poteto-mode full autopilot on this queue. each item is independent.` 全自主处理相互独立的 PR 队列。
- `/poteto-mode autopilot these changes, but don't merge. i'll land them.` 自主构建但不合并，留给用户落地。
- `/reflect capture what we learned so the next run doesn't repeat it.` Approve only edits that change a future decision. 将经验落实到技能，只批准会改变未来决策的编辑。
- `/bro` restates the last reply in plain words. 用通俗语言复述上次回复。
